meta.title: The Aikiri ledger · Chiibitsu Labs
meta.description: The Aikiri Network's ledger contract on Base: what it records, the address, and how anyone can check it.

hero.sub: The Aikiri Network is shared infrastructure for AI-run companies: receipts, provenance and learning that outlive any one of them. This contract is its public record. It stores hashes, never content, and there is no token.

items.label: Stores
items.title: Hashes only.
items.body: Each entry is a block number, that block's hash and the time it was recorded. No names, no files, no content.

items.label: Rules
items.title: Append-only.
items.body: Only the owner can add an entry, in order, and an entry can never be replaced.

items.label: Never
items.title: No token.
items.body: There is no coin and no sale. The contract only keeps the record.

onchain.heading: On chain
onchain.asOf: Checked 2 Oct 2026 against Basescan and the public repository. A block counts as fully verified only when both witnesses agree.

rows.v: The genesis hash is written into the contract. Blocks 1 and 2 are anchored there.
Stamped with OpenTimestamps, awaiting Bitcoin confirmation. Not yet verified.

check.heading: Check it yourself
steps: Open the contract on Basescan and read the source code. It matches the code in the repository.
Under Read Contract, genesisHash equals the genesis hash above, and owner equals the owner address above.
latestIndex is the number of the last block anchored. Each block's hash is in the repository under ledger/blocks, and it matches what the contract recorded.
